ours-search.citation: media/school/search/facts.json, written by tools/school/fill_search.mjs from system/school/search.mjs: linear and binary search, insertion and merge sort with counters, on sizes 8 to 65,536 and seeds 1 to 10, with 134 closed-form checks, a binary-search-on-unsorted control and Node timings.
claims: Every count in the film, the closed-form checks and the control.
ours-search.n: 10 seeds per size; all keys for binary search.
ours-search.interval: Min and max over seeds in facts.json.
ours-search.does_not_prove: Times on other machines or engines; counts are of comparisons only.

knuth3.short: Knuth, The Art of Computer Programming, vol. 3, 2nd ed. (1998)
knuth3.citation: Donald E. Knuth, The Art of Computer Programming, Volume 3: Sorting and Searching, 2nd edition, Addison-Wesley, 1998; sections 5.2.1 (insertion), 5.2.4 (merging), 6.2.1 (binary search).
claims: The standard treatment of these algorithms and their costs.
knuth3.does_not_prove: The film's exact counts, which are measured here; the section text was not read for this film.

clrs.short: Cormen, Leiserson, Rivest and Stein, Introduction to Algorithms, 4th ed. (2022), chapter 2
clrs.citation: MIT Press, 2022; 2.1 Insertion sort, 2.3 Designing algorithms (merge sort).
claims: Insertion sort and merge sort as described.
clrs.does_not_prove: The film's counts; the book uses its own cost model.
